title: Monster Hunter
desc: Captain Artemis and her soldiers are pulled into a world where dangerous monsters and humans co-exist. They must escape with the help from a hunter.

title: Batla House
desc: After a fatal Batla House encounter, officer Sanjeev Kumar faces backlash while battling trauma. Determined, he hunts the culprits amid rising pressure and emotional turmoil.

title: Major
desc: Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan heroically fights during a terrorist attack at the Taj Hotel, joining the task force and putting his life on the line for many innocents.

desc: An Indian diplomat tries to repatriate an Indian girl from Pakistan, where she was presumably forced and deceived into marrying against her will.

title: Judwa No.1
desc: Twin brothers separated at birth grow up differently. When one is kidnapped, fate brings them together, revealing secrets and testing the strength of their newfound bond.
